description: The lowest fire class or listing a country asks for in a kind of building or space (escape route, general area, high-rise, tunnel, hospital, data centre, plenum, riser) for DE, ES, FR, GB, IT, TR and US: the rule lines with their sources and seen levels, makers' declarations marked as such, the US NEC listing ladders (CMP, CMR, CL3P ...), or not found. Free, deterministic, no LLM.
